option_text:
OPTION 1: Auto Scaling Group with Application Load Balancer
RECOMMENDED

Best for: Traditional applications, predictable workloads, cost-conscious deployments
Cost: $250-400/month

Key points:
- ALB distributes traffic across 2 Availability Zones ($16/month + data processing)
- Auto Scaling Group with 2-4 t3.medium instances ($120-240/month total)
- RDS Multi-AZ database for automatic failover ($70/month, <2min failover)
- 2 NAT Gateways for outbound internet ($65/month)
- VPC Flow Logs to S3 for compliance monitoring ($10/month)
- 3-tier subnet design (public, app, data) across 2 AZs meets SOC 2 availability requirements

Tradeoffs:
- Manual patching and AMI updates required
- Fixed costs even at low utilization
- Lower per-unit cost than Fargate at steady loads
- Best control over instance configuration
